messages:
maya: Heads-up — running the sampleapp with the new adaptive windowing patch and hitting a weird 429 cascade. Repro steps attached.
maya: TL;DR: client-side window grows too fast on burst embed requests, then pagination token gets reused and we see duplicate items + 429 spikes.
sam: omg that sounds like the off-by-one we saw in go-sdk's batching logic last month. Any logs? :eyes:
maya: Pasting the relevant console snippet:
```
2026-03-18T15:02:12Z [throttle] window_size=32 target=16 inflight=40
2026-03-18T15:02:12Z [request] page_token=abc123 status=429
2026-03-18T15:02:12Z [retry] using token=abc123 attempt=2
2026-03-18T15:02:12Z [request] page_token=abc123 status=200 items=10
```
eli: The inflight > window_size line is the smoking gun. The adaptive controller should clamp window_size down when we hit persistent 429s, not keep increasing.
olga: Is this specific to embeddings or also generation/polling flows? maya: observed on bulk-embeds job + the sampleapp's cursor paginator. Didn't see on single-stream gen.
sam: Did the SDK honor the Retry-After header? If not, that could cause tight immediate retries that look like duplicates.
maya: It does honor Retry-After, but the window controller currently ignores per-request Retry-After and only looks at aggregated error rate. So bursts with mixed headers confuse it.
eli: Quick mitigation: cap the adaptive window to the median concurrency of the last 1s and add a wobble guard. I can PR a tiny change to the controller tomorrow.
maya: That would help. Also the paginator should rotate page tokens on retries to avoid replaying the same token in parallel.
olga: Could we instrument a metric for "token-reuse-after-retry"? Preferably low-overhead in sampleapp so we can catch this in customer repos.
sam: Agreed. We should also add a smoke test in the sampleapp CI that runs a synthetic burst and asserts no duplicate ids in results.
eli: I'll file a quick issue and attach a PoC patch: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sampleapp/pull/421
maya: Nice. FYI deploy-bot just threw a staging deploy for the sampleapp change earlier today.
deploy-bot: Staging deploy succeeded for sampleapp@staging — build 2026.3.18-78 :rocket:
olga: Thanks everyone. For short-term triage, I'm going to flip the adaptive controller to conservative mode in our dev build and run the bulk-embeds job overnight.
maya: Thanks — will report back with logs in the morning. If anyone hits this in the wild, ping me and tag @maya so I see it immediately. :white_check_mark:
